attribution.note: Zitron's own words in his own newsletter post, stated in his voice ('I must repeat'). It is not a quotation of anyone else.

semantics.note: An unqualified 'will' is a scored forecast. However, the same post earlier says 'upwards of $200 billion of capital expenditures since 2023'. 'I must repeat' points back to that, so the start date (2023) is given in context. The normalised claim wrongly says it is unstated. The measure and the calendar-versus-fiscal year remain unspecified.

contract.note: The contract attributes the 'since 2023' scope only to a later post, but it appears in this same post. Fixing the start date at 2023 would narrow the ambiguity. The choice of measure (cash capex versus capex including finance leases) and fiscal versus calendar year still decides the result, and the speaker supplied neither.

output.rationale: This is a forecast with an elapsed horizon (end of 2025). The packet contains no evidence items and no capex figures; the one source considered was not used. Without dated figures for cumulative spending since 2023 on a defined measure, the packet cannot settle whether more than $200B was spent. The outcome is unresolved.
